description: Create a durable saved build for the authenticated user. A spec-only build is supported and preferred for agent-created configurations because the web uploader hydrates it and generates its own webState on resume. Portable specs support the full v1 launch surface, including campaign-qualified texts.perAdset entries and per-campaign profile.campaigns identity overrides. Web-captured builds can launch without uploadId when spec.mediaItems carries a mediaHash for every image and mediaId for every video, with missing library-video thumbnails recovered from Meta at preview/create. Do not construct webState by hand. Only provide webState when round-tripping a webState previously read from a build without changing its structure. accountId is optional when it can be derived from webState.selectedAccount.accountId, webState.selectedAccount.account_id, or spec.accountId. Confirm that the build was saved. If the user has an open uploader tab, do not repeat the returned url; share it only when the user asks for it or says the tab is closed. For a new headless build with no open uploader tab, give the returned url so the user can open and review it. Use ads_create with buildId to launch it when spec.launchable is true. launchable only describes headless ads_create launches; a launchable:false build still opens and can be edited in the web uploader. Unresolved video identifiers must be repaired before launch. Missing library-video thumbnails are recovered from Meta at preview/create; only the thumbnail image is uploaded, never the video. For videos, mediaItems[].mediaId MUST be the numeric Facebook video id from the upload response videoId, not its internal id. videoId is accepted as an alias. linkedAssets[] follow the same rule. Internal upload ids are resolved on save only for uploads owned by the authenticated user in the selected account; otherwise a video without a numeric id or batch link makes the build unlaunchable. Canonical 4x5 primary with linked 9x16 item: {"mediaName":"X__H01.mp4","mediaType":"video","mediaId":"1805649190475379","thumbnailHash":"PRIMARY_THUMBNAIL_HASH","placementType":"portrait","isGroupPrimary":true,"assetGroupId":"ag_1","linkedAssets":[{"mediaName":"X__H01-9x16.mp4","mediaType":"video","mediaId":"1234567890","thumbnailHash":"STORY_THUMBNAIL_HASH","placementType":"story"}]} Save and update return display.totalAdSets, display.totalAds and the ads in each ad set as the web uploader renders them. Compare these with preview totals before creating. If display.complete is false, read its reason before comparing. Fields in display.inheritedFromSource.fields come from the source ad or preset. With inheritedFromSource.loadedAt they show its values; otherwise they are null (see reason), so read them from ads_preview. Existing destinations show adSetId and campaignId; names show when they are the ad set or campaign of the source ad. Treat any other mismatch for a complete display as a bug and call ads_report_issue with buildId, expected and actual. Preset-only requests reuse the saved campaign and ad set, including saved builds. Preview and create add a non-fatal PRESET_DESTINATION_USED warning. Use campaign.name or named multi-campaign entries for new campaigns, or campaign.id / adSet.id to override the saved destination. With campaign.id alone, new ad sets are created. copyFromAd behavior is unchanged.

accountId.description: Optional ad account ID. The server can also derive it from webState.selectedAccount.accountId, webState.selectedAccount.account_id, or spec.accountId.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes stored on the build.

spec.description: Portable launch specification. Spec-only creation is supported and preferred for agent-created builds.

webState.description: Opaque web uploader session snapshot. Do not construct it by hand. Only provide webState when round-tripping a snapshot previously read from a build without changing its structure.
